sentences.en: A neighbour cooked meat in his yard.
The smell rose in the whole street.
Juha stood beside the fence and smelled.
The neighbour saw him and did not invite him.
In the evening Juha asked him for a pot.
He said: I am cooking tomorrow.
The neighbour asked: what are you cooking?
Juha said: meat, a lot of meat.

sentences.ar: השכן נתן לו את הסיר מהר.
sentences.en: The neighbour gave him the pot fast.

sentences.ar: בבוקר הוא בא לבית של ג'וחא.
sentences.en: In the morning he came to Juha’s house.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: באתי לראות מה שלומך.
sentences.en: He said: I came to see how you are.

sentences.ar: על האש עמד הסיר, וריח עלה.
sentences.en: On the fire stood the pot, and a smell rose.
The neighbour sat and waited a long time.
In the end Juha opened the pot.
Inside it were only water and a stone.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: אתמול היה לך בשר.
sentences.en: Juha said: yesterday you had meat.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: והיום יש לי ריח.
sentences.en: He said: and today I have a smell.
